lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: The pilgrimage is complete. As promised, traveller: fuel.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: You did not disturb our rites. That shows wisdom. We have another task for wise ones.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: An egg. Warm. Precious. It must reach the golden world, the one they call Fun Planet.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: We pay up front. Fuel and supplies, enough for a long and comfortable journey.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: What hatches is not your concern. Deliver it and your concern ends.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: Warm is how it likes to be. Keep it warm. Do not sing to it. It sings back.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: Well, traveller? Will you carry our egg?

options.line: What exactly is inside this egg?
